era: DS / Wii / HD farming action RPG
summary: Marvelous's fantasy life-sim action RPG series, born from Story of Seasons/Harvest Moon and expanded across handheld, console, and PC releases.

entries.title: Rune Factory: A Fantasy Harvest Moon

emulation.notes: Use legal cartridge dumps and a stable dual-screen capture layout.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native DS rendering with clean scaling.

primary.version: Original Nintendo DS release via melonDS
primary.why: The first Rune Factory only released on Nintendo DS, so DS emulation is the cleanest capture route for the complete original.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped DS cartridge image in melonDS with a readable dual-screen layout, or play on original DS/3DS hardware.

entries.title: Rune Factory 3: A Fantasy Harvest Moon

emulation.emulator: None for primary; melonDS for the DS original
emulation.notes: Native PC release is preferred. Use DS emulation only for original-version comparison.

primary.why: Rune Factory 3 Special is an expanded HD remake on Switch and PC, with redesigned models and quality-of-life upgrades; the PC version has the best capture ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play Rune Factory 3 Special on Steam. Use the Digital Deluxe content only if you want its cosmetic swimsuit mode active.

entries.remaster_caveats: Special is a modernized remake/remaster of the DS game; Digital Deluxe adds cosmetic swimsuit mode DLC.

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps and test current compatibility. Dolphin is a viable fallback for the Wii version.

primary.why: Tides of Destiny/Oceans released on Wii and PlayStation 3; the PS3 version is the higher-resolution console route and RPCS3 gives the best capture ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS3 disc in RPCS3, testing compatibility before a full run. Wii via Dolphin is the fallback if RPCS3 issues appear.

entries.title: Rune Factory 4

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Lime3DS/Azahar for the 3DS original

primary.why: Rune Factory 4 Special adds enhanced graphics and extra modes/content over the 3DS original; the PC release includes the Another Episode DLC and has the best capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play Rune Factory 4 Special on Steam or Microsoft Store, with Another Episode included. Use 3DS only for original-version comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Special is an enhanced port/remaster; use the PC/2021 release for included DLC content.

entries.title: Rune Factory 5

primary.why: Rune Factory 5 released on Switch and later PC; the PC release is the highest-fidelity route and the cleanest capture setup.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam version on PC at stable settings. Use Switch only if portability is the priority.

entries.remaster_caveats: No Special/remaster release is documented as shipped.

entries.title: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC release with current patches.

primary.why: Guardians of Azuma released on Switch, Switch 2, and PC in 2025, with PS5 and Xbox Series X/S following in 2026; the PC version offers the best capture/settings ceiling while retaining current update content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC with all current updates installed. Re-check DLC/update state before starting a long archive run.

entries.remaster_caveats: Because the game is recent, verify update and DLC state before a stream run.
